38/S0.subgoal: Explain the overall scope and focus of the lecture on interface and interaction design.

38/S1.subgoal: Identify the fundamental issues when designing an immersive experience.

38/S2.subgoal: Describe the diverse approaches for initiating the design process.

38/S3.subgoal: Compare and contrast generic versus specific design guidelines.

38/S4.subgoal: Explain the concept of a design language and the role of prototypes in specification.

38/S5.subgoal: Differentiate between specific and generic guidelines in the context of extended reality systems.

38/S6.subgoal: Introduce and outline Shneiderman's Eight Golden Rules for enhancing usability.

38/S7.subgoal: Apply Shneiderman's Eight Golden Rules to design usable interactive systems.

38/S8.subgoal: Classify the different interaction techniques utilized in Extended Reality environments.

38/S9.subgoal: Summarize the key concepts covered regarding design, guidelines, and interaction techniques.
